import CategoryTheory.Functor
import CategoryTheory.NatIso
import Data.Finset
import Data.Nat

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u₂, u₁} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor C FintypeCat) {X Y : C} (i : X ≅ Y) : Nat.card (F.obj X).obj = Nat.card (F.obj Y).obj := by
  let σ : F.obj X ≅ F.obj Y := NatIso.ofComponents.app F F (λ _ => id) (λ _ _ => rfl) i.is_iso
  let f := σ.hom
  let inv_f := σ.inv
  have h : Function.Bijective f := by
    constructor
    · intro x
      exact Finset.mem_image.1 (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ x) (Finset.mem_univ x))
    · intro y
      exact Finset.mem_image.1 (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ y) (Finset.mem_univ y))
  exact Nat.subtype_card f (Finset.card_eq_of_bijection f inv_f)
